messages:
marta_sales: FYI Connex wants an expedited POC to validate Okta SSO + SCIM group->role mapping and confirm domain ownership flow. They also asked for a Dedicated vs Hosted cost differential for ~100M tokens/mo. Suggested slot: Fri 11am PT.

leo_se: I can run the session. Quick Qs for Connex: expected users/groups for the trial? SP or IdP-initiated SAML? Any strict cert-rotation cadence?

connex_idp_admin: SP-initiated. Start with ~600 users and ~250 groups. Cert rotation quarterly. Need SCIM delta <3m for provisioning.

anya_sec: Security check: Hosted supports TLS and AES-256; BYOK available via KMS for Hosted (customer-provided) but we must complete vendor questionnaire first. Dedicated supports HSM. We'll need their SOC2 and DPA request. Also confirm EU residency needs.

chris_prod: Product notes: SCIM supports incremental sync with cursor paging; default Hosted throttle 5 rps (configurable on Dedicated). Group->role mapping supports precedence rules; we can run a sample mapping file. Domain verification: DNS TXT or email ownership.

leo_se: Minimal mapping example I'll send in the invite:
```
{"Connex-Admins": "org-admin", "Platform-Eng": "eng-write"}
```

dena_legal: Legal ask: please get their legal contact. I'll prepare DPA + SOC2 Type II and check deletion SLA requests. If they require EU Dedicated, contracts will reflect that in the DPA.

marta_sales: Pricing ask from Connex: "If we go Dedicated in EU for compliance, what's the monthly delta vs Hosted for 100M tokens?"

chris_prod: Rough ballpark: Hosted consumption ~ $0.0008/token -> ~$80k/mo. Dedicated adds infra/ops premium; expect +$20-45k/mo depending on replication/DR. Finance to confirm. For the POC we can reserve a short dedicated slot (7-14 days).

leo_se: Action items: I'll draft the POC runbook and invite Connex + their Okta admin + legal. Anya: please send the vendor questionnaire and BYOK checklist. Dena: prepare DPA + SOC2. Marta: confirm Fri 11am PT with Connex.

connex_idp_admin: Confirmed Fri 11am PT. We'll send SP metadata and a test admin account by EOD Thu.

marta_sales: Thanks all ":thumbsup:" I'll update Connex and post the runbook in #eng-se.
